Description.description: One reviewer answer to one question version inside one review instance. The answer is held in the typed column that matches the question version's response type (FR-012, AD-022).
Union of every single-select answer value used by V8. The permitted subset for a given answer is fixed by the question version's response type and enforced server-side (AD-022).
Answer for every single-select response type, including the BR-005 grade and the Primary root cause. Where CRP does not apply the recorded value is N/A rather than an absent response (AD-021).
Values available to multi-select questions. V8 has one: Tax check reason (AD-022).
Answer for multi-select response types. A case can fail for several tax reasons at once, which is why Q-TAX-01 is multi-select.
Answer for Date response types. Date-only, so it does not shift across time zones.
Answer for Text and Multiline text response types, including case notes, fail observations and Even Better If.
Short label identifying the response in lists.
A response answers the exact wording that was presented, not the current wording. Restrict delete is the schema-level guarantee behind AD-004 and BR-013.

Review instance code joined to the question version code. As an alternate key this enforces one response per question version per review instance, and makes a repeated write idempotent under NFR-REL-01.
Unique identifier for the response.
Responses are parented by their review instance. Cascading assign and share is what makes BR-012 access to a review carry to its answers without a second security rule.
